system.description: You fight or face down a captured apex predator, such as a bear or a great wolf.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the beast never rolls Morale while you live.
outcomes.success: The beast becomes your loyal companion: a Moderate minion that fights for you, carries your gear and would die for you. It counts toward your minion limit.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the beast will not bow.
outcomes.ruin: The beast bows to no one, and it is free. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
